desc: Read input N and the list P.
Initialize a Binary Indexed Tree (BIT) of size N+1 where each position is initially 1 (representing an empty slot).
For i from N down to 1, find the P_i-th empty position using binary search on the BIT prefix sums.
Place the number i at the found position in the result array.
Mark that position as occupied in the BIT by updating it with -1.
